scope: Reconcile two priority identity judgments and define evidence requirements after the v3.2-to-v3.3 migration audit.

pair.name_b: data center de Google Chile en Cerrillos

decisions.rationale: The source record behind project A explicitly says FIMA opposed Google's data-center project planned between Cerrillos and San Bernardo. The source record behind project B identifies Google's planned Cerrillos data center and separately mentions the earlier Quilicura facility. Therefore the historical decision against a generic 'Data Center' pair cannot be transferred to this exact pair. This is a same-project candidate, not authorization to rewrite project IDs, aliases, conflicts, or case-mention links.

pair.name_b: Plan Maestro de Ciudad Parque Bicentenario

decisions.rationale: The historical separation reason concerned a different 'Parque Bicentenario' homonym and does not decide this pair. Official planning material describes Ciudad Parque Bicentenario as an urban development and its Plan Maestro as a planning instrument that guides development. They are related, but the evidence supports preserving project-versus-plan granularity rather than treating the labels as aliases. The typed relationship itself remains a candidate pending the ontology's accepted relation vocabulary.

migration_drift_reconciliation.interpretation: The label is directional: a v3.3-side row may indicate an item absent from v3.2; a v3.2-side row may indicate an item not carried into v3.3. These are not one undirected count of confirmed extraction errors. The four v3.2-side rows include three Line 7 descriptions whose difference may be granularity rather than omission.

future_pair_adjudication_gate.applies_to: Any remaining unresolved pair and any historical decision being transferred to a new v3.3 pair.
required_per_pair: Both exact project_ids and canonical names, plus the source document(s) attached to each ID.
A direct source URL and/or immutable local source reference with SHA-256.
A short exact quote or page/paragraph locator supporting the proposed identity or distinction for each side.
Explicit relation class: same identity, parent/component/phase, related plan or instrument, distinct entities, or unresolved.
Check for geographic, temporal, developer, project-stage, and homonym contradictions; do not transfer evidence across projects or case mentions.
Confidence, unresolved limitations, reviewer attribution, and production_promoted=false until a separate release gate approves the change.
future_pair_adjudication_gate.insufficient_evidence_action: Leave unresolved; do not infer from substring, shared case_id, or an inherited historical decision alone.

audit_artifact_coverage.interpretation: These counts describe what the submitted review artifact preserves. They do not prove that no external research occurred; they mean most adjudications cannot be independently audited from that artifact.
